values.label: Accepts Contents
values.description: Generic capability phrase; not a distinct container state.

values.label: Empty Container
values.description: Container that currently contains no items. Needs human review and evidence.

values.label: Energy Container
values.description: Container for stored energy (e.g., battery, capacitor). Needs evidence.

values.label: Filled Container
values.description: Container that contains at least one item. Needs human review.

values.label: Fluid Container
values.description: Container designed to hold fluids. Needs evidence.

values.label: Gas Container
values.description: Container designed to hold gases. Needs evidence.

values.label: Has Contents
values.description: Generic state; not a specific container behavior or state.

values.label: Pattern Template
values.description: Container that holds a crafting pattern/schematic. Needs evidence.

values.label: Reusable Mold
values.description: Mold that can be used multiple times. Needs evidence.

values.label: Single Use Mold
values.description: Mold that breaks after one use. Needs evidence.
